::: {.prose}
GEMS is an **Open** project. Every tool in the family is shared openly on this site: record forms, instructions, normative data and cut-offs, scoring sheets, analysis code and apps.
All of them are released under the **[Creative Commons Attribution – NonCommercial 4.0 International licence (CC BY-NC 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)**.
You can use, translate and adapt them in clinical and research settings, as long as you credit the original work and do not use them commercially.
:::
:::

## Licences at a glance

The article column shows the publisher's licence for each paper. That licence is separate from the licence of the test materials.


| | Test materials | Code and apps | Scientific article |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[GEMS](tests/gems/index.qmd)** | [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) | R analysis code and Shiny app for cut-offs, [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), [download](https://github.com/giorgioarcara/gems-tests/releases/tag/materials-v1) | Open access, Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY), *Brain and Behavior* (2022) |
| **[Tele-GEMS](tests/tele-gems/index.qmd)** | [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) | R analysis code and Shiny app for cut-offs, [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), [download](https://github.com/giorgioarcara/gems-tests/releases/tag/materials-v1) | Published in *Neurological Sciences* (2023); not open access |
| **[Auto-GEMS](tests/auto-gems/index.qmd)** | [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) | Source code (JATOS study archives) and Shiny app, [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). It runs on [JATOS](https://www.jatos.org/), which is Apache 2.0 | Open access, [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), *Aging Clinical and Experimental Research* (2024) |

## What you can do

::: {.can-grid}
::: {.can}
<i class="bi bi-check2-circle"></i>

**Use**

Administer the tests at no cost, for non-commercial clinical practice and research.
:::

::: {.can}
<i class="bi bi-translate"></i>

**Translate and adapt**

Translate the materials, adapt them to other cultures, and collect new normative data.
:::

::: {.can}
<i class="bi bi-share"></i>

**Share**

Redistribute the materials non-commercially, keeping the authorship and the CC BY-NC 4.0 licence notice.
:::

::: {.can}
<i class="bi bi-quote"></i>

**Credit**

Always cite the original article of the test you use. The references are on each test page.
:::

::: {.can .nc}
<i class="bi bi-slash-circle"></i>

**Non-commercial**

Selling the materials, or using them in paid products or services, requires written permission. [Contact us](contact.qmd).
:::
:::

::: {.prose}
## Good practice

- Download the materials from this site, so you always have the latest version of the forms and instructions.
- If you translate or adapt a test, [let us know](contact.qmd). We are glad to list new language versions on this site, each with its own flag.
- The Cognitive Reserve Index questionnaire (CRIq), used to compute the cut-offs, is a separate instrument. It is available at [cognitivereserveindex.org](https://www.cognitivereserveindex.org/NewEdition/) under its own terms.

The licence terms stated on the materials themselves take precedence over this summary.
:::
